svg.title: The next question calls the next card
svg.desc: A rack of six shelves holds notes in the order they happened, newest at the bottom. On the rail in front, four cards stand in the order they were sent: the newest first, glowing, then the cards three questions called, out of the rack's order. Two cards stay on their shelves, and the next place on the rail is an empty dashed outline: the listener's.
